validity.recommendation: check whether an existing Vologda-Cherepovets branch already operates; the 176 km and 700/1000 mm figures may describe it, not the new project
validity.researcher_notes: The neftegazpro article (24 January 2024) confirms a design-stage project with Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta as customer and 4.5 bcm per year. A Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta training deck lists a 'Vologda-Cherepovets (1 thread)' branch with DN 1000 for km 0-30.4 and DN 700 for km 30.4-176 as part of the existing linear system, which matches the sheet's length and diameter exactly. So the sheet's 176 km and diameters may come from an existing line and not from the proposed build. The owner may also be Gazprom Transgaz Ukhta LLC (named as customer) and not Gazprom PJSC. The decree list the wiki cited no longer carries the item.

verifications.note: Проектный объём транспортировки газа составляет 4,5 миллиарда кубических метров в год
